status_semantics.complete: Pinned public API and runtime behavior are implemented and referenced by an executable behavioral test.
status_semantics.partial: A canonical binding exists, but pinned API surface or runtime semantics remain incomplete.
status_semantics.deferred: The canonical feature is intentionally unavailable or has no functional binding yet.

classes.name: FastNoise2
classes.evidence: Full pinned surface present: all 6 methods and 22 properties with pinned defaults, all 33 constants, remap applied with the upstream Remap formula and terrace with the upstream Terrace construction (smoothness normalized to [0,1]), generate_image implemented (compressed images rejected, pixels normalized by the observed sample range, non-tileable; tiling logs a one-time warning) and covered by the api smoke test. Honest partial: this port substitutes the pure-Rust fastnoise-lite engine for the C++ FastNoise2 library (no numeric parity, get_simd_level always scalar), encoded_node_tree is stored but not decoded, and cellular index-based lookups approximate via distance variants.

classes.name: VoxelGenerator
classes.evidence: Pinned surface complete: generate_block(out_buffer, origin_in_voxels: Vector3, lod) is exposed on the base and overridden on every concrete generator class (origin type matches the pinned XML and upstream C++; truncating Vector3i conversion like Godot). Abstract base body is a faithful no-op; concrete overrides run the core generator into the buffer. gdext 0.5.4 cannot inherit user-defined classes, so concrete generators keep a flat Resource base with inherited pinned members re-declared. Behavioral test pins the generate_block contract (solid/air fill and SDF sign flip) via the core-backed free functions.

classes.name: VoxelGeneratorFlat
classes.evidence: Pinned surface complete: channel, height, voxel_type properties with pinned defaults plus generate_block; create_core_generator forwards all three into the core Flat generator. Extra height_int alias retained. Behavioral tests pin the blocky fill, channel mapping and SDF sign flip through the extracted parameter function, and the live runtime is exercised by the blocky-terrain smoke scene.

classes.name: VoxelGeneratorGraph
classes.evidence: Feasible pinned subset implemented and tested: clear, compile returning the pinned {success, node_id, message} report, debug_analyze_range via core interval analysis, raycast_sdf_approx with stride/step bounds, debug_load_waves_preset, debug_measure_microseconds_per_voxel, generate_image_from_sdf (65 536-pixel budget), generate_block, all seven pinned members with validation (use_xz_caching is wired to the core XZ-prefix cache flag with output-equivalence tested; the other five are stored-but-inert pending core culling support), TEXTURE_MODE constants and the node_name_changed signal declaration. Remaining blockers: bake_sphere_bumpmap/bake_sphere_normalmap need panorama baking support absent from the core, and get_main_function requires the VoxelGraphFunction registry rework (separate stage).

classes.name: VoxelGeneratorHeightmap
classes.evidence: Pinned surface complete: channel, height_start, height_range (pinned default 30), iso_scale and offset all forward into the core HeightmapParams (previously only height_range did), plus generate_block. Extra sample_height retained. Behavioral test pins full parameter forwarding and the offset field shift.

classes.name: VoxelGeneratorImage
classes.evidence: Pinned surface complete: image property (void set_image pinned name, get_image) storing the last assigned Image with compressed images rejected like upstream, blur_enabled wired to the upstream 5-tap cross kernel with wrap-around fetches, height_range pinned override default 200, red-channel sampling (upstream reads red, not luminance), repeat-by-default wrap, inherited channel/height_start/iso_scale/offset all forwarded, plus generate_block. gdext 0.5.4 cannot inherit user-defined classes, so inherited pinned members are re-declared on the concrete class (flat Resource base). Behavioral test pins red-channel reading, clamp/repeat wrap, iso/offset forwarding and the blur flag; the core blur has its own wrap-around unit tests.

classes.name: VoxelGeneratorNoise
classes.evidence: Pinned surface complete: channel, height_start, height_range and the required noise resource plus generate_block. The assigned noise resource drives generation through its ClassDB getters with per-class enum decoding (ZN_FastNoiseLite and FastNoise2 encodings differ and are mapped separately); unknown resource classes log and fall back to the sampler default. Own seed/frequency remain the documented fallback when no resource is assigned. Core NoiseConfig honors fractal passthrough. Behavioral tests pin determinism per configuration, seed divergence, channel wiring and the per-class noise-type decode.

classes.name: VoxelGeneratorWaves
classes.evidence: Pinned surface complete: pattern_size and pattern_offset now actually drive the core Waves generator (previously they were inert and legacy amplitude/period drove generation), inherited height_start/height_range (default 30)/iso_scale/channel/offset re-declared and forwarded, plus generate_block. gdext 0.5.4 cannot inherit user-defined classes, so every inherited pinned member is re-declared on the concrete class (flat Resource base) and the terrain accepts generators via per-type casts. Legacy amplitude/period remain as write-through deprecated aliases. Behavioral test pins canonical parameter forwarding (regression for the inert-property defect), phase shift under pattern_offset and the surface crossing range; the runtime smoke scene drives paging with this generator.

classes.name: VoxelGraphFunction
classes.evidence: The pinned API is a node-type registry with an edge list (32 methods, 58 constants (57 NodeTypeIDs + NODE_TYPE_COUNT), IO definitions, sub-graph function nodes); the core graph is an AST with embedded ports and no per-node metadata or connection objects. Structural gap, scheduled as its own later stage; the current binding keeps only the extras (set_name/get_name, compile_and_sample) that the graph editor addon drives.

classes.name: ZN_FastNoiseLite
classes.evidence: Everything except warp_noise is implemented: the four sampling methods with the pinned Vector3 signature for get_noise_3dv (previously Vector2), true 2D sampling (previously a 3D slice), 13 properties with pinned defaults and all 24 pinned constants; the engine is the same fastnoise-lite library upstream wraps, so numeric parity is real. warp_noise stays absent because it requires ZN_FastNoiseLiteGradient, which is deferred with the GPU-adjacent gradient work.

classes.name: ZN_SpotNoise
classes.evidence: Pinned surface complete and functional against the upstream model: 2D checks only the containing cell and 3D uses true 3D cells (floor on all axes, 3-component hash, 3D squared distance), matching util/noise/spot_noise.h at the pinned commit. The jitter hash and lane decoders mirror upstream's exact wrapping-32-bit math, so spot centers are numerically upstream-identical. get_spot_positions_in_area_2d/3d enumerate one center per covered cell with a 65 536-cell workload bound; noise evaluation and enumeration share the same centers, so per-cell membership agreement is exact. Behavioral tests pin expected centers (including the jitter=0 exact case), workload bounds, noise/enumeration agreement and the upstream hash constants.
